name: inside_bar_breakout_v177
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, sharp 5-second directional bars (≥5 index points range) represent algorithmic momentum bursts where a single institutional order temporarily dominates. The subsequent inside bar forms as market makers reprice and resting limit orders absorb the thrust — a micro-equilibrium where neither bulls nor bears commit. When the next 5-second bar closes beyond the inside bar's boundary in the direction of the mother bar, trapped opposing-side stop-losses trigger and the momentum algos re-enter, driving a 10-20 spot point continuation. The 5s resolution lets us enter at the exact moment directional consensus re-establishes, 30-90 seconds before the move completes.

indicators.name: is_inside
indicators.purpose: Structural relationship — detects whether bar i is fully contained within bar i-1. No time scaling needed: an inside bar is a bar-count concept (1 bar back), not a time-duration concept. Valid at any frequency.

indicators.name: mother_range
indicators.purpose: Range of the mother bar (the bar that the inside bar was contained within). Used to filter noise: at 5s on NIFTY, tiny inside bars (e.g., 1-2 pt range mother) are pure microstructure noise with no directional content. Require ≥5 pts to ensure a meaningful directional thrust preceded the consolidation.

indicators.name: trend_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute trend momentum. At 5s holds (15-60s), we want breakouts aligned with the prevailing 3-minute direction. 36 bars = 3 min is the right trade-trigger lookback: shorter than 5-min (context filter) but longer than the inside bar micro-pattern itself. NOT 12x the original's lookback — original used no trend filter; we add it specifically to reduce false breakouts at 5s noise levels.

conditions: Previous bar (i-1) was an inside bar: high[i-1] < high[i-2] AND low[i-1] > low[i-2]
Mother bar range (high[i-2] - low[i-2]) >= min_mother_range_pts threshold
Current close breaks above inside bar high: close[i] > high[i-1]
buy_ce.confirmation: Close above inside bar high (not just a wick)

conditions: Previous bar (i-1) was an inside bar: high[i-1] < high[i-2] AND low[i-1] > low[i-2]
Mother bar range (high[i-2] - low[i-2]) >= min_mother_range_pts threshold
Current close breaks below inside bar low: close[i] < low[i-1]
buy_pe.confirmation: Close below inside bar low (not just a wick)

exit.stop_rationale: Inside bar breakouts on NIFTY that fail reverse quickly — if the move was not genuine, price returns to the inside bar range within 5-10s (≈2-5 spot pts). At delta ~0.5, a 6 spot pt reversal = 3 option pts. 3 pts cuts the losing trade before the false breakout extends into a full reversion.
exit.target_rationale: A successful 5s inside bar breakout on NIFTY typically extends 10-15 spot pts in the first 60 seconds as the trapped-side stops clear. 5 option pts ≈ 10 spot pts at delta 0.5, capturing the median first-leg move at 1:1.67 risk-reward.

filters.vix_filter: none — pattern is structural, not regime-dependent
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST — avoid pre-open gaps and EOD illiquidity
filters.volume_filter: implicit via mother bar range requirement (large range implies large volume at 5s)
filters.trend_filter: 36-bar (3-min) momentum must align with breakout direction
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — stop-hunt algos specifically prey on inside bar breakouts; wicks can trigger false signals at 5s resolution

adaptation_notes: Original used 15-min bars on nifty200 stocks (top 50 by volume) with volume surge confirmation. The core inside bar concept translates directly to NIFTY 5s bars. Three key changes: (1) Replaced equity volume surge with mother bar range threshold — index volume at 5s is too noisy to be meaningful, but a large-range mother bar implies significant order flow. (2) Added 36-bar (3-min) trend filter — at 5s, inside bars are far more frequent than at 15-min, so trend alignment filters down to high-conviction setups. (3) Compressed stops/targets from ATR-multiples (designed for 30-60 min holds) to option premium points calibrated for 15-60s holds on NIFTY.
weaknesses: At 5s resolution, inside bars are common even in flat/noisy markets — mother bar range filter is critical but may still over-trigger
Wick-hunting algos can trigger the breakout condition on a 5s wick that immediately reverses before the next bar
Session open (first 15 min) can produce exaggerated mother bars unrelated to intraday trend, generating false signals
